basic_details.job_title: UP Anganwadi Moradabad Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Online for 316 Posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years. The age of the candidate will be computed as of 01 July 2026. The date of birth recorded in the High School marksheet and certificate will be considered valid.

qualification.details: Candidates must be citizens of India and residents of Uttar Pradesh. | Applicants must be female candidates and must be residents of the same Gram Sabha (for rural areas) or Ward (for urban areas) from where they are applying.

selection_process: The selection process for Anganwadi Sahayika is based entirely on an online merit process conducted through the official portal. No written examination or interview will be conducted.
how_to_apply: Go to the official website at upanganwadibharti.in.
Read the detailed notification and instructions carefully before filling out the application form.
Register on the portal and enter all required personal, educational, and category details accurately.
Upload self-attested copies of required documents, photographs, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Verify all entered details, as incorrect entries or mismatches with educational certificates will result in direct rejection.
Submit the final application form online on or before 28 October 2026 (up to 12:00 midnight).
Keep a printout or digital copy of the submitted application form for future reference.
important_instructions: Only online applications submitted through the official departmental portal upanganwadibharti.in will be accepted. Hard copies sent via post or offline modes will not be entertained. Applicants must enter their marks, certificate numbers, issue dates, and category details carefully, as online verification will be performed automatically from portal data. Any discrepancy in data or mismatched document details will lead to automatic rejection of candidature without prior notice. Female candidates must belong to the respective Gram Sabha or urban ward to be eligible for selection in that specific area. No written test or interview will be held for selection; the entire process is handled directly via the online portal. Candidates must complete their online registration and submission by the final deadline of 28 October 2026.

rows.details: Bal Vikas Seva evam Pustahar, Uttar Pradesh

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Moradabad Vacancy Details (Project-wise)
content_sections.text: A total of 316 vacancies are available across various project areas in Moradabad district.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Moradabad Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be citizens of India and residents of Uttar Pradesh. Applicants must be female candidates and must be residents of the same Gram Sabha (for rural areas) or Ward (for urban areas) from where they are applying.

rows.qualification_required: Intermediate (Class 12th) or its equivalent examination passed from a recognized board.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Moradabad Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years. The age of the candidate will be computed as of 01 July 2026. The date of birth recorded in the High School marksheet and certificate will be considered valid.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Moradabad Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Moradabad Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for Anganwadi Sahayika is based entirely on an online merit process conducted through the official portal. No written examination or interview will be conducted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UP Anganwadi Moradabad
content_sections.text: Go to the official website at upanganwadibharti.in . Read the detailed notification and instructions carefully before filling out the application form. Register on the portal and enter all required personal, educational, and category details accurately. Upload self-attested copies of required documents, photographs, and certificates in the prescribed format. Verify all entered details, as incorrect entries or mismatches with educational certificates will result in direct rejection. Submit the final application form online on or before 28 October 2026 (up to 12:00 midnight). Keep a printout or digital copy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: High School marksheet and certificate (for date of birth verification) Intermediate or equivalent qualification marksheet and certificate Residence proof (Gram Panchayat Adhikari / Sahayak Nagar Nikay issued certificate, husband's death certificate and family register copy for widows, or competent court order for divorced/destitute women) Caste certificate and income certificate issued with online digital signature from Tehsil Self-attested copies of all supporting documents uploaded during online application

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Moradabad Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only online applications submitted through the official departmental portal upanganwadibharti.in will be accepted. Hard copies sent via post or offline modes will not be entertained. Applicants must enter their marks, certificate numbers, issue dates, and category details carefully, as online verification will be performed automatically from portal data. Any discrepancy in data or mismatched document details will lead to automatic rejection of candidature without prior notice. Female candidates must belong to the respective Gram Sabha or urban ward to be eligible for selection in that specific area. No written test or interview will be held for selection; the entire process is handled directly via the online portal. Candidates must complete their online registration and submission by the final deadline of 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is UP Anganwadi Moradabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment notification issued by Bal Vikas Seva evam Pustahar, UP, to fill 316 contractual vacancies for the post of Anganwadi Sahayika in Moradabad district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Moradabad Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 316 vacancies have been announced across various blocks and urban projects in Moradabad district.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for UP Anganwadi Moradabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 28 October 2026 up to 12.00 midnight.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Anganwadi Sahayika?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Intermediate (Class 12th) examination or its equivalent from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UP Anganwadi Sahayika recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 years and 35 years of age as of 01 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for UP Anganwadi Moradabad posts?
faq.answer: Eligible female candidates can apply online through the official portal at upanganwadibharti.in by uploading the necessary documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be a written exam or interview for selection?
faq.answer: No written examination or interview will be conducted; selections are finalized entirely through an online merit process on the portal.
